item.title: Satellite megaconstellations continue to grow. Could their debris fall on us?
item.description: As more satellite megaconstellations continue to be launched, researchers are exploring the odds people could be struck by falling debris from reentering spacecraft.

item.title: SpaceX launches Crew-12 astronauts to short-staffed International Space Station. 'We have left the Earth, but the Earth has not left us.'
item.description: SpaceX launched NASA's Crew-12 mission with a quartet of astronauts aboard Crew Dragon Freedom today (Feb. 13), bound for an eight-month stint on the International Space Station.

item.title: Why solar and lunar eclipses come in pairs — and what an eclipse season really is
item.description: Eclipses don't happen at random — they arrive in pairs, on schedule, and 2026 brings two spectacular seasons to prove it.

item.title: If the Winter Olympics went interplanetary, where else could you ski in the solar system?
item.description: We take a look at the best (and worst) places to ski in the solar system, logistics aside.

item.title: Artemis 2 rocket photobombs SpaceX Crew-12 | Space photo of the day for Feb. 13, 2026
item.description: One to orbit, one to the moon.

item.title: Markiplier's 'Iron Lung' is a welcome return to grindhouse sci-fi films of the '90s
item.description: YouTube's superstar serves up a disturbing indie thriller bathed in blood for his directorial debut

item.title: Excited for The Mandalorian and Grogu later this year? Walmart is offering an Exclusive preorder price for the Lego New Republic X-Wing Starfighter set
item.description: If you're a fan of Lego Star Wars and are excited for The Mandalorian and Grogu, you'll want to build Walmart's exclusive New Republic X-Wing Starfighter set.

item.title: Has 'Star Trek: Starfleet Academy' just unleashed its very own Khan?
item.description: After an inauspicious debut, Paul Giamatti's space pirate has emerged as a villain to be reckoned with on 'Star Trek: Starfleet Academy.'

item.title: A mystery object is dimming a distant star. Could it be a massive exoplanet, or a 'failed star'?
item.description: A mysterious object has caused a long-lasting and extreme dimming of a distant star, but is this object a 'failed star' brown dwarf, or an exceptionally massive super-Jupiter exoplanet?

item.title: 'The beacons were lit!' Scientists name merging supermassive black holes after 'Lord of the Rings' locations
item.description: Scientists have named two systems of colliding supermassive black holes after Lord of the Rings locations, Gondor and Rohan.
